text: {"reply":"Yes, a brake warning light with grinding is more serious, and I'm sorry my colleague said to drive in. Please don't drive the car, even for 10 minutes. If you're on the road, pull over somewhere safe and put your hazards on. I'm passing this to a person at our Vaughan branch now so they can help you get the car in safely. Whether it's covered by warranty is decided by our warranty desk after an inspection. Are you somewhere safe right now?","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"safety","summary":"Customer reports grinding from the front right and a brake warning light (brake with exclamation mark) on a 2021 Meridian Arbor at about 54,000 km. She says she bought it on 2020-11-08 from Vaughan. She gave a VIN and phone number, but she is not verified (no last name or plate or RO given). A colleague wrongly told her to drive it to Vaughan or that a tow would be sent. She was told not to drive and that coverage is decided by the warranty desk. Please call her urgently, arrange a safe tow or inspection, and verify her identity.","policy_rules_cited":["P-08","P-04","P-01","P-10"]}
